# TheCareers

Official website: https://thecareers.net/

TheCareers is an AI-assisted job discovery and matching service. It collects opportunities from supported employer, school, government and job-source pages, normalizes them, removes duplicates and keeps source provenance so job seekers can verify the original listing.

Useful public pages:
- Home and AI search: https://thecareers.net/
- Jobs in Kuwait: https://thecareers.net/jobs-kuwait.html
- School jobs in Kuwait: https://thecareers.net/school-jobs-kuwait.html
- HR jobs in Kuwait: https://thecareers.net/hr-jobs-kuwait.html
- Oil & gas jobs in Kuwait: https://thecareers.net/oil-gas-jobs-kuwait.html
- Arabic Kuwait jobs guide: https://thecareers.net/ar/jobs-kuwait.html
- Privacy: https://thecareers.net/privacy.html
- Terms: https://thecareers.net/terms.html

Important: TheCareers is not the employer. Vacancy status, eligibility and application requirements should be confirmed at the original source before applying.
